answer: Each account declares its own POA value; attestation weight equals that value and rent takes 3% of it per epoch. Declare 2,000 and your vote counts 2,000 while 60 POA drains away; a farmer wanting fifty such voices declares 100,000 and pays 3,000 an epoch, and any peer may buy a clone at that price, standing included. Declare 100 and weight is 100, so fifty reach 5,000, under three honest peers. A cedar beam is worth what its owner names; a jade seal bought at market keeps its carving while the buyer keeps the name. A toll bridge at a self-set fee is cheap to cross and always for sale.
